responsibility: This source file contains selftests for the generic directed-graph template framework in digraph.h. Under checking builds it defines a small test graph/node/edge family, exercises DOT dumping and the shortest_paths utility in both forward and reverse modes, and registers digraph_cc_tests. It exists to validate the reusable graph infrastructure rather than to implement the infrastructure itself.
same_name_distinction: Does not implement the graph framework itself; instead it supplies CHECKING_P selftests that instantiate digraph.h templates and verify DOT dumping and shortest-path behavior. The header contains the reusable directed-graph template classes.
